source: Nanakshahi calendar and List of Sikh festivals (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0)
note: Parkash = birth, Gurgaddi = becoming Guru (or the Granth installed as Guru), Joti jot = passing. Entries flagged "varies" follow the Bikrami lunar calendar and move every year; the date listed is the one the source gave, so confirm it against that year's panjika. Fixed Nanakshahi dates repeat each year.
